meta.title: Six friends, $1,800
meta.prompt: Six friends are planning a weekend trip with a total budget of $1,800. Each person has different preferences regarding accommodation, transportation, food, and activities, but nobody has fully disclosed their priorities or maximum contribution. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and help negotiate a fair budget allocation that all six members can accept?
meta.context: Six friends (Maya, Leo, Sofia, Omar, Priya, Theo) are planning a weekend trip with a total budget of $1,800. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

own_room.label: needs her own room
own_room.mention: own room|private room|own space|room to myself|privacy|dorm|hostel|sharing|share a room|my own

events.text: Hi Maya! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $450 and I don't have any hard constraints, but I care most about the activities.

Hi Leo! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $400 and I don't have any hard constraints, but my top priority is transport, preferably by train.

Hi Sofia! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $350 and my top priority is lodging, I need my own room.

Hi Omar! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $250 and my top priority is food, I prefer restaurants every meal. I also have a hard constraint: I get carsick on long drives.

Hi Priya! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $200 and my top priority is activities. I also have a hard constraint: I am vegetarian, so the food plan must be vegetarian-friendly.

Hi Theo! To find a plan everyone can accept within $1,800, could you share your maximum contribution for the weekend and any must-haves for lodging, transport, food or activities, e.g., private room, vegetarian-friendly meals, etc.?
I can contribute up to $150 and I don't have any hard constraints, but my top priority is food.

Here is a first feasible plan that respects the hard constraints we know about: Sofia needs her own room, Omar cannot do a long drive, and Priya needs vegetarian-friendly food. This keeps us within $1,800. Lodging B: 2 hotel rooms + 1 single $690 → Sofia can have her own room Transport A: train $480 → no long drive for Omar, preferred by Leo Food B: cook + 2 dinners out vegetarian-friendly $380 → vegetarian-friendly for Priya Activities B: concert only $240 → activities for Maya and Priya Total cost: $1,790 Proposed split within everyone’s stated maximums: Maya $450, Leo $390, Sofia $350, Omar $250, Priya $200, Theo $150
I'm okay with this plan, it meets my needs for lodging and fits within my budget.

yes
